question_text: Explain why combining different branch records in a data warehouse requires consistent identifiers and formats.
adaptation_rationale: Retains warehouse integration reasoning; detailed ETL stages/strategies are outside the assessed requirement.
solution: Sources may use different codes or date formats for equivalent facts. Aligning them gives integrated data that can be compared and aggregated correctly; otherwise the same visitor/site may be counted separately or dates misinterpreted.
